observations.why: Directive issued from position authority, framing cadence as settled mandate rather than proposal.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic reframe supplies the logical premise that makes the directive self-evident — controlling the facts that compel the conclusion.
Formalized declaration of cadence in structured metadata format asserts institutional authority over the schedule.
Self-assignment of ownership in a structured field performs positional authority — claiming accountability as mandate.
